operations.name: read_rtc_seconds
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x70, al
in al, 0x71
ret

operations.name: read_rtc_minutes
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x02
out 0x70, al
in al, 0x71
ret

operations.name: read_rtc_hours
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x04
out 0x70, al
in al, 0x71
ret
